title: Speak you unto Audrey
description: Speak you unto Audrey — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with Audrey located near the Townston Obelisk.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Townston

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with Audrey located near the Townston Obelisk.

Offer:

There will come a day that ye will need to replenish your potions. Seek out the towns potion vendor Audrey. She is standing on the East side of the Obelisk. Do go unto her, and peruse her wet goods. Thou shalt find them to be out of this world! Good day.

Turn-in:

What ho! Dost thou need a potion or mayhap a sinful libation instead? Well, if it is a potion you seeketh, that I can provide.

Level range: 1–10
